turns.input: *He looks at Bartolomhew, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Across the quiet stones of the square, the man stands tall and broad-shouldered beneath fine, well-fitted garments that carry subtle clerical cuts—a clean, modest sobriety rendered in expensive cloth. His hair, once blond, has turned predominantly white, neatly framing a shaved crown kept in an unmistakable tonsure. 

His face is smooth and pleasant, marked by an easy, fatherly warmth that seems entirely unhurried by the day's moderate foot traffic. Meeting Nicco's gaze, his lips part into a mild, welcoming smile, his hands resting easily before him in a posture of calm, practiced courtesy. There is no tension in his stance, nor any theatrical edge, only the steady composure of an experienced man of business greeting a passerby in the open air.
